verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken structure. The four steps are scattered down the strip out of order (3, 2, 4, 1), split apart by the jar and the CTA, and their step text is tiny and hard to read at this size. The pink circle is cropped awkwardly at the bottom-right, and the bottom 20% is left almost empty while the headline fills the top. A edges ahead only because its logo is larger and more legible; B's logo is very small, though its jar fills the width a little better.
